pulse_ai_transformation_mastermap.mission: From Hackathon Prototype to Clinical Grade Medical Device

strategic_pillars.failure: String-based ASCII serial transmission with no checksums (GIGO Risk).
strategic_pillars.market_prior_art: Apple Watch uses proprietary binary protocols with CRC and pre-processing on-device before cloud storage.
strategic_pillars.strategic_crack: Implement COBS-encoded binary stream plus CRC-16. Dirty packets are dropped and user is prompted to hold still.

strategic_pillars.failure: Plaintext PHI handling paths and leaked credential artifacts.
strategic_pillars.market_prior_art: Medical telemetry leaders use strict key management and encrypted storage silos.
strategic_pillars.strategic_crack: Enforce client-side AES-256 encryption, rotate compromised keys, isolate PHI store, and gate all sensitive APIs with auth.

strategic_pillars.failure: Heuristic-heavy logic and unstable operating point on real-world data.
strategic_pillars.market_prior_art: Clinical systems validate on large noisy datasets with strict performance gates.
strategic_pillars.strategic_crack: Adopt probabilistic deep model refresh, SQI gating, and constrained policy tuning with specificity and recall floors.

strategic_pillars.failure: Jittery stream rendering under network burst/lag.
strategic_pillars.market_prior_art: Clinical monitors use hardware-timed rendering and deterministic buffering.
strategic_pillars.strategic_crack: Implement frontend jitter buffer with fixed delay and stable render cadence.

strategic_pillars.failure: Partial FHIR implementation and non-standard report payloads.
strategic_pillars.market_prior_art: Hospital systems depend on strict HL7-FHIR R4 and DICOM waveform interoperability.
strategic_pillars.strategic_crack: Implement full HL7-FHIR R4 profile conformance and DICOM serialization path for integration.

strategic_pillars.failure: Limited explainability and weak traceability for clinical reasoning.
strategic_pillars.market_prior_art: State-of-the-art ECG AI uses interpretable saliency and segment-level attribution.
strategic_pillars.strategic_crack: Add XAI heatmapping and evidence trace output for each arrhythmia decision.

regulatory_milestones: FDA De Novo or CE MDR Submission
pulse_ai_transformation_mastermap.steve_jobs_mantra: Aesthetics are a result of engineering perfection. If it is not solid at the core, it is not beautiful.
